name: 15857 · Saint Marys, PA
findings: ZIP 15857 (Saint Marys) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15857 (Saint Marys) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15857 (Saint Marys) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 31.0 times the typical level).
